annotations.title: Get Bing index/crawl info for one URL

description: GetUrlInfo + optionally GetChildrenUrlInfo: index/crawl metadata (anchor count, discovery/last-crawled dates, HTTP status, whether Bing considers it a page) for one URL on a project's matched Bing site, and, when includeChildren is set, the same metadata for every URL Bing discovered under it. FREE (no credits). Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

includeChildren.description: Also fetch the index/crawl metadata for URLs discovered under this one (one page of Bing's own pagination). Default false.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_bing_url_info
